messages:
Morgan: kicking off a quick healthshake for the new gpu-subcluster (zone: eu-central-2). want a tight checklist we can run in <30m.
Jin: here — I put a short runnable checklist in the thread. minimal steps only.
Sara: +1, prefer smoke -> connectivity -> perf -> handoff. add a cost sanity check too.
Morgan: ok. I'll run and post results. tagging @Jin for command snippets.
Jin: commands:
```
# node & driver checks
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl describe node <suspect-node>
nvidia-smi -L

# pod smoke
kubectl run test-gen --image=redwood/test-gen:latest --restart=Never --command -- /bin/sh -c "python smoke_gen.py --tokens 64"

# health endpoint
curl -sS http://10.10.5.12:8080/health | jq .

# simple perf (latency sample)
hey -n 200 -c 10 http://10.10.5.12:8080/generate
```
Sara: I'll validate networking: iptables, CNI, and cross-az routes. quick iperf between 2 nodes: `iperf3 -c <peer>`
David: infra-qa-bot will run infra liveness probes and return a short summary. could also check cloud provider quotas before we hand over.
infra-qa-bot: probe-results: nodes=8/8 READY; driver=470.142; disk-pressure=0; pod-oom-events=0 (48h).
Morgan: first pass results: nodes show ready, driver present, but one node shows intermittent `DiskPressure` for ~2m then recovered. logs attached.
Jin: paste the `kubectl describe node` snippet? need to see Kubelet eviction thresholds.
Morgan: pasted: "EvictionThresholds: nodefs.available < 10% (observed 9%)" — the problematic node had a temp build left on /var/lib. cleaned it.
Sara: network checks: CNI flaps on startup for new pods ~15s, cross-ns conn validated. iperf: 9.8 Gbps intra-rack, 2.2 Gbps cross-az (expected).
David: cost sanity: spot vs on-demand mix looks fine. estimated monthly GPU hrs ~ 2.3k -> ~$12k at current reserved pricing. call this out in handoff doc.
Morgan: perf smoke: test-gen completed, avg latency 110ms p50, p95 360ms. hey sample shows tail p99 ~ 720ms during batch warmup.
Jin: suggest enabling prefix caching for the initial traffic pattern and set batch max to 16 for this region. small change in pool config: `batch.max_tokens=4096`, `batch.max_requests=16`.
Sara: SLO gate pass? p95 < 500ms target. looks ok; p99 is above but transient. recommend A/B rollout with conservative traffic % then escalate.
Morgan: agreed. I'll prepare the short handoff note: include node incident, network perf numbers, command snippets, infra-qa-bot summary, cost estimate, and recommended rollout policy.
David: add rollback steps and a contact list (oncall + eng-infra + perf lead).
Morgan: done — handoff draft uploaded to the runbook folder. final ask: reactions? :thumbsup: for go-ahead to schedule canary.
Jin: :thumbsup:
Sara: :thumbsup:
David: :thumbsup:
Morgan: scheduling canary for 21:00 UTC. will post results in same thread.
